NOTIFICATION 
General Administration Department 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar 
Dated the 27th November, 2015 
 
No.GS/41-2015/SCV/102008/197350/G2 Cell:- In exercise of the powers 
conferred by the proviso to article 309 of the Constitution of India, the 
Governor of Gujarat hereby makes the following rules further to amend 
the Under Secretary, Class I, in the Gujarat Secretariat Service, 
Recruitment Rules, 2012, namely :- 
 
1. 
These rules may be called the Under Secretary, Class I, in the Gujarat 
Secretariat Service, Recruitment (Amendment) Rules, 2015. 
 
2. 
In the Under Secretary, Class I, in the Gujarat Secretariat Service 
Recruitment Rules, 2012, in rule 2, in clause (a), in sub-clause (i), for 
the words "eight years", the  words "seven years" shall be 
substituted. 
 
 
By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujarat, 
 
 
( K. M. Adhvaryu ) 
Additional Secretary to Government 
 
To, 
• The Secretary to the Hon. Governor of Gujarat,  Gandhinagar.   
• The Chief Principal Secretary to the Hon. Chief Minister, Gandhinagar. 
• The Personal Secretary  to the Hon. Speaker of Gujarat  legislative  
Secretariat, Gandhinagar. 
CONSTITUTION 
OF INDIA.
